build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like _graph _autograd or _functions
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn native extensions with cmake 3.5.1 or higher
load_readme_description: load the README.md file to use as the long description for the gtn package
setup_gtn_package: setup the gtn package with seven CMake extensions and python bindings for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
